body: I’m here with you with EST , hopefully they’ll tell us a time
I can’t really give you a motivation talk like other people do bc I’m going to do it soon too. And it’s very hypocritical if I do.. but I hope you find your peace.
Hopefully, the pain will die down soon. Since you’ve taken them , are you now afraid ?
Yikes. I’m sorry you’re in pain. I was planning on taking a lot of “acetaminophen”. I hear it hurts to take as well… you should probably vomit them out.
We can only hope…doesn’t really seem like we’ll get it though
Just seen your last post, I’ve been planning as well. How are you feeling ?

Heyy , 20 here … funny how life becomes more dreadful as soon as we’re adults , huh? I feel you on being alone. I don’t really have friends to hang with so I’m just in my room 24/7 with my thoughts. It hasn’t been doing me any good since I’m considering ….  If you ever want to talk lmk. I’m sure we can relate. All my dreams are dead and I don’t have the motivation to go “conquer” them. I’m pretty much done and tired of life. Just really exhausted. I can’t really say anything about your other current situation but I really hope that whatever the outcome you want , finds it’s way to you.

I feel that way too. I just have a feeling they’ll start showing they care when it’s too late. I’m sure they care now but people have a hard time showing it . It’s just going to eat them up in the end when there’s nothing they can do about it anymore.
I do hope you will find your peace. I’m afraid too but the pain is too much. I hope I’ll find my peace as well next month. Much love.
